title: See Amid the Winter's Snow
description: See Amid the Winter's Snow in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 7 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Edward Caswall, first published in 1851. The tune, HUMILITY, is by John Goss (1870). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: See a-mid the win-ter's snow, Born for us on earth be-low, See, the gen-tle Lamb ap-pears, Pro-mised from e-ter-nal years. Hail that ev-er bles-sèd morn, Hail re-demp-tion's hap-py dawn, Sing through all Jer-u-sa-lem: Christ is born in Beth-le-hem.

lines: Born for us on earth below,
He Who built the starry skies;
He Who, thronèd in height sublime,
Why have you now left your sheep
"As we watched at dead of night,
Lo, we saw a wondrous light;
Told us of the Savior's birth."
What a tender love was Thine,
Thus to come from highest bliss
Down to such a world as this.
Teach, O teach us, holy Child,
By Thy face so meek and mild,
